import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: Contains 2017 data columns (no Region, no 2015 data)
df_2017 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Load Source 1: Contains 2015 data columns + Region + Country
df_2015 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Rename Source 1 columns to match target schema suffix "_15"
df_2015_renamed = df_2015.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# Select only the columns needed from 2015 data
df_2015_selected = df_2015_renamed[[
    'Country', 'Region', 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15'
]]

# Rename Source 0 columns to match target schema suffix "_17"
df_2017_renamed = df_2017.rename(columns={
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Happiness_Rank_17',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'Happiness_Score_17',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'Whisker_High_17',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17': 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17': 'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'Life_Expectancy_17',
    'Freedom_17': 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17': 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17': 'Trust_17',
    'Dystopia_17': 'Dystopia_17'
})

# Source 0 has no Region column, so we will get Region from Source 1 by joining on Country
# Join 2017 data with 2015 data on 'Country' to get Region and 2015 data
# We use 'Country' as the join key because it is common and unique enough in both datasets

# Before join, ensure 'Country' columns are consistent in both dataframes
# (strip whitespace, unify case if needed)
df_2017_renamed['Country'] = df_2017_renamed['Country'].str.strip()
df_2015_selected['Country'] = df_2015_selected['Country'].str.strip()

# Merge on 'Country' to combine 2015 and 2017 data
df_merged = pd.merge(df_2015_selected, df_2017_renamed, on='Country', how='inner')

# The merged dataframe now contains all columns needed for the target table:
# ['Country', 'Region', 2015 columns..., 2017 columns...]

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Convert data types explicitly to match target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'Country': 'string',
    'Region': 'string',
    'Happiness_Rank_15': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_15': 'float',
    'Standard_Error_15': 'float',
    'Economy_15': 'float',
    'Family_15': 'float',
    'Life_Expectancy_15': 'float',
    'Freedom_15': 'float',
    'Trust_15': 'float',
    'Generosity_15': 'float',
    'Dystopia_15': 'float',
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'float',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'float',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'float',
    'Economy_17': 'float',
    'Family_17': 'float',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'float',
    'Freedom_17': 'float',
    'Generosity_17': 'float',
    'Trust_17': 'float',
    'Dystopia_17': 'float'
})

# Save the final dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {output_path}")
